subject: Increase size of the "titles" on the x-axis

messages.author: a8ea54a97ac8fe2b
messages.subject: Increase size of the "titles" on the x-axis
parts:
Hi all,

Because I do not know the terminology for the "titles" on the x-axis, I have to attach the graph. The "titles" are "farmed cod", "wild cod", and "farmed salmon" in the graph.

I have two questions. First, what is the term for these "titles" on the x-axis? Second, how can I increase the sizes of these "titles"?

Thank you.

Kind regards,

Xianwen

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Increase size of the "titles" on the x-axis
parts:
They're called axis titles, and for plot p you can change the size like this:

p + theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=20)

See ?theme for many more examples.
Ben
